title: Core: Symbol 9-slice scaling grid
description: Unit tests for 9-slice grid (scale9Grid) on symbols. A Symbol with scale9Grid set should export to SWF with the EnableVideoSmoothing or SetTabIndex tag that encodes the 9-slice rect. Test that scale9Grid properties are preserved in FLA round-trip. Tests in packages/core/src/engine/__tests__/scale9grid.test.ts.
